events.title: HARD Summer Music Festival
events.detail: Open-air fest HARD Summer returns with a globe-trotting line-up boasting Tokischa, salute, Charlotte de Witte, Zack Fox, Shygirl, VTSS and hometown heroes CQUESTT and Dj Warning.
reasons: +12 tracked artist (Amelie Lens, Charlotte de Witte, Chris Lorenzo, DJ Seinfeld, Mau P, Vintage Culture)

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno powerhouse, KNTXT label boss — hard, hypnotic peak-time techno; a tracked name and one of the strongest bookings on this lineup.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Miami-via-Barcelona producer (Eric Estornel) — tech-house and techno crossover, Ellum Audio boss; deep, dark, groove-driven.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

artist_notes.name: Shygirl
artist_notes.note: UK rapper/vocalist and NUXXE co-founder — hyperpop-adjacent club music, Sega Bodega/Arca collaborator; more art-club than DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — tracked name; huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish-Argentine producer (Armand Jakobsson) who pioneered 'lo-fi house' — tracked name; hazy, nostalgic house that's a shade more tasteful than most of this bill.

artist_notes.name: Chris Lorenzo
artist_notes.note: UK bass/house producer, Half Baked label — tracked name; UK garage-inflected, bass-heavy house.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival — one of the more interesting names on the bill if you like that skippy, rave-adjacent garage sound.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

artist_notes.name: Andy C
artist_notes.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

artist_notes.name: Etari
artist_notes.note: LA-based (Orange County-raised) producer and AUNTIE co-founder — house through trance and techno, with releases on 100% Silk; regular on the Lights Down Low/HARD Summer circuit.

artist_notes.name: Nick León
artist_notes.note: Miami producer on TraTraTrax and Future Times — fuses dembow, reggaeton and dancehall rhythm into house/techno (his own coined term: 'arquitectronica'); one of the more genuinely distinctive club producers right now, sun-bleached and heavy in equal measure.

artist_notes.name: Pegassi
artist_notes.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

enrichment.curator_note: This is the maximalist, 68-name-deep HARD Summer bill — Charlotte de Witte, VTSS and Amelie Lens give the techno stage real weight, but the day is mostly festival-scale bass/electro/hyperpop stuff outside the lane. Go for a handful of sets, not the whole grounds.
enrichment.description: Day one of HARD Summer at Hollywood Park Grounds, Inglewood — 60+ act electronic/bass festival lineup including Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, VTSS, DJ Snake, Boys Noize and Zedd.

verdict.why: Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens are genuine top-tier techno headliners, but they're two sets buried in a 60-act bass/trap/hard-dance day festival — worth catching, not a night built for the …

events.series_key: run:hard summer music festival|hollywood park grounds

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: Chicago ghetto-house/footwork pioneer, founding Dance Mania crew alongside DJ Deeon and Paul Johnson — raw, high-BPM, chant-hook club tracks; the sound Daft Punk sampled on 'Teachers.'

enrichment.curator_note: Baile World is one of LA's best global-club rooms (founded by DJ CQUESTT, built around femme/POC selectors), and landing a Dance Mania originator like DJ Slugo is a real coup — footwork/ghetto-house rather than straight house, so know what you're walking into, but it'll move.
enrichment.description: Secret-location DTLA afterhours party (11pm) from the Baile World series, headlined by Chicago ghetto-house pioneer DJ Slugo.

verdict.why: DJ Slugo is Dance Mania royalty — genuine house history — but ghetto-house/footwork sits a step outside the core lane, so it's more curiosity than must.

events.title: Certified Groovers with Demuir, Juliet Mendoza & More…

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto-based, Chicago-schooled house producer — Beatport's #1 Jacking House producer 2015/2016, credited with coining the 'Jackin House' tag; 600+ tracks deep on Hot Creations and Classic. Funky, sexy, groove-first house.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

enrichment.curator_note: A TBA DTLA warehouse night built on jacking, groove-first house rather than techno — Demuir basically invented this lane, and Juliet Mendoza's local pedigree makes the rest of the bill trustworthy.
enrichment.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours party with Demuir, Juliet Mendoza, and more, 10pm.

verdict.why: Demuir is the producer who coined the 'jacking house' tag — funky, groove-first, TBA-location afters is exactly your Saturday lane.

events.title: A Club Called Rhonda with TEED, Jacques Greene, Kindness (DJ), Shaun Ross & more

artist_notes.name: TEED
artist_notes.note: Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs — UK producer Orlando Higginbottom, glossy nu-disco/synth-pop ('Trouble', 'Household Name'); shiny and danceable, not a deep-digger set.

artist_notes.note: Adam Bainbridge — London songwriter/producer steeped in disco, funk and R&B (collabs with Robyn, Blood Orange, Kelela); DJs in the same warm, groove-forward lane as his records.

artist_notes.name: Shaun Ross
artist_notes.note: Model known for breaking barriers in fashion who's become a recurring guest/performer at Rhonda parties — more scene presence than DJ set, so treat as texture on the bill.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: Loren Granich — Rhonda's own co-founder/resident, playing the sexy house-and-disco sound the party was built around.

events.title: Lights Down Low feat. dh2 Takeover

artist_notes.name: Nikki Nair
artist_notes.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

artist_notes.name: George Daniel
artist_notes.note: The 1975's drummer moonlighting as a dance producer/DJ — founded the label dh2 out of afterparty DJ sets; plays bass-leaning, UK-rap-inflected electronic sets, not a genre veteran but a genuine crate-digger's side project.

enrichment.curator_note: Lights Down Low has been LA/Bay Area's best-kept afterhours secret for over a decade, and Nikki Nair is one of the most inventive bass-techno hybridizers going right now — a real reason to stay out late even with a curiosity booking like George Daniel on the same bill.
enrichment.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (11pm) from long-running party Lights Down Low, featuring bass/techno producer Nikki Nair and The 1975's George Daniel (dh2 label) DJing.

verdict.why: Nikki Nair is a genuine Dirtybird/Lobster Theremin talent and Lights Down Low is a real long-running afters — George Daniel's the curiosity here, not the draw.

artist_notes.name: Tauceti (FR)
artist_notes.note: French techno/ambient producer with a growing profile in that scene — couldn't pin down a label home, so treat this as a promising rather than proven booking.

artist_notes.name: Mha iri
artist_notes.note: Edinburgh-raised, Melbourne-forged techno DJ/producer — big-room-meets-emotional sound with her own vocals, now signed to PIAS and releasing on Adam Beyer's Drumcode; genuinely on the rise (Awakenings, Tomorrowland, Hï Ibiza in the last year).

artist_notes.name: Gerard Not Gerald
artist_notes.note: Co-founder and resident of INCOGNITO itself (formerly Franco Benito) — has held down LA's underground techno scene for over a decade, sharing decks with Kevin Saunderson, Kenny Larkin and DJ Pierre.

enrichment.curator_note: Mha iri's Drumcode pedigree is the real signal here — a proper warehouse booking from a promoter that's been quietly building LA's underground techno scene for a decade.

events.title: Post Present Medium    25 Year Anniversary Celebration, Night III…      Abe Vigo
events.detail: Post Present Medium    25 Year Anniversary Celebration, Night III…      Abe Vigoda    Callahan & Witscher ‍  ‍ (NYC)    Debt Rag ‍  ‍ (Olympia, WA)    The Intima ‍  ‍ (Portland, OR)    DREAM_MEGA      Plus DJ Cate Kennan!      8:00 pm    Advance $20 single day tickets available    here   . artist_notes.name: Abe Vigoda
artist_notes.note: LA experimental/'tropical punk' band from the mid-2000s Smell scene, on Post Present Medium — jittery, humid, post-punk-meets-tropicalia; this run is a reunion set for the label's anniversary.

artist_notes.name: Callahan & Witscher
artist_notes.note: NYC duo of two veteran underground experimentalists (Jack Callahan, aka die Reihe; Jeff Witscher, aka Rene Hell) whose new project is a surprising, hooky pivot toward songs after years of noise/ambient work.

artist_notes.name: Debt Rag
artist_notes.note: Olympia, WA punk trio (former members of Grass Widow and Girlsperm) playing guitarless, clattering, drum-and-keyboard punk — Post Present Medium's 2023 LP 'Lost to the Fantasy.'

artist_notes.name: The Intima
artist_notes.note: Portland post-punk quartet, violin-driven, active 1999-2004 and recently reunited — shared stages with The Rapture and The Mekons back in the day; PPM reissued their 'Peril and Panic' LP.

enrichment.curator_note: Three nights deep into Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary run and this one's genuinely stacked — Abe Vigoda's tropical-punk reunion, Callahan & Witscher's weird new pivot into actual songs, and DIY lifers Debt Rag and reunited Portland post-punk act The Intima. This is the Smell's classic guitars-and-noise lane, not the club side of things.
enrichment.description: Night three of The Smell's Post Present Medium 25th-anniversary celebration: reunited LA tropical-punk band Abe Vigoda, experimental duo Callahan & Witscher, Olympia's Debt Rag, and reunited Portland post-punk band The Intima.

verdict.why: A 25-year anniversary night for Post Present Medium's roster (Abe Vigoda and co.) at The Smell is exactly the DIY punk/experimental scene the brief calls out — legendary room, real lineage.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Massimiliano Pagliara, Masha Mar, James Axon

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

enrichment.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

events.title: FLOAT Rooftop Pool Party feat. Apache [2-8 PM]
events.detail: Poolside beats, curated cocktails, and skyline views above the city.

artist_notes.name: Apache
artist_notes.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

enrichment.curator_note: A genuine rooftop-pool day party — Apache isn't a name you'll recognize, but Abracadabra's house lane is legit groove, not brostep-adjacent EDM, and the setting alone (2-8pm, DTLA rooftop) is the Sunset-Sessions kind of afternoon you like.
enrichment.description: Daytime rooftop pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8 DTLA headlined by Miami house DJ Apache.

enrichment.curator_note: Same Scotty Boy energy you'd expect from him anywhere — reliable jackin'-house-and-disco-edits, but it's closer to populist brunch-party polish than a proper selector's after-hours set.

events.title: Factory 93 presents: Amelie Lens at Grand Park Block 2
events.detail: Amelie Lens takes over Grand Park for a dynamic, extended day-to-dusk set spanning techno, acid, trance and more, Belgium style.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: SoCal-raised, now a fixture of LA's underground techno scene (SXTCY resident, founder of the VSCRL event series) — dark, textured, experimental techno sets.

enrichment.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
enrichment.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina

enrichment.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
enrichment.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

events.detail: The winner of four 2024 Tony Awards®, including Best Musical, is THE OUTSIDERS.Adapted from S.E. HINTON’s seminal novel and FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA’s iconic film, this thrilling new musical features a book by ADAM RAPP with JUSTIN LEVINE, music and lyrics by JAMESTOWN REVIVAL (Jonathan Clay & Zach Chance) and Tony Award® winner JUSTIN LEVINE, music supervision, orchestration, and arrangements by JUSTIN LEVINE, choreography by RICK KUPERMAN & JEFF KUPERMAN, and direction by Tony Award® winner DANYA TAYMOR. Entertainment Weekly says, "THE OUTSIDERS has the power to inspire an entire generation."In Tulsa, Oklahoma, 1967, Ponyboy Curtis, his best friend Johnny Cade and their Greaser family of ‘outsiders’ battle with their affluent rivals, the Socs. THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self- discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. With a dynamic original score, THE OUTSIDERS is a story of friendship, family, belonging…and the realization that there is still “lots of good in the world.”

events.title: Bonnie Raitt: Live 2026 with Special Guest Jon Cleary
lineup: Jon Cleary & the Absolute Monster Gentlemen
events.detail: Bluesy singer/songwriter Bonnie Raitt has worked long and hard for her multiple Grammy Awards, hit singles and chart-topping records. Since her 1971 eponymous debut, the California-born performer and long-time activist has steadily maintained a music career, albeit with definite peaks and valleys. The red-headed songstress, one of the only women of her time to play guitar using the bottleneck technique, unleashed seven albums in just nine years, though her big commercial break came with her 10th studio set, 1989’s “Nick of Time.” That 11-track collection, produced by Don Was, earned three Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Not only has the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer tackled multiple U.S. tours and international runs, but she’s also a frequent participant in events of social activism, such as Farm Aid and Amnesty International concerts. Raitt’s 16th full-length album and most recent studio release, “Slipstream,” hit retailers in 2012. Not only did ticket sales for the support tour soar, but Raitt also landed the best-selling blues album of the year and took home the Grammy for Best Americana Album.

# The narrative — the taste in prose. This is the highest-signal part of the editor's brief;
# keep it current as your taste moves.
narrative: >
  Curated as an electronic head: the spine is house / techno / tech-house across the spectrum —
  from rooftop-vinyl-groove and proper European club nights all the way to mainstream
  festival/big-room headliners (Chris Lake, FISHER, etc. ARE priority, not noise). A recurring
  favorite — one kind of event he likes, not the be-all: "Sunset Sessions at Golden Hour DTLA" —
  chill rooftop, vinyl, house, European feel. But don't let "tasteful" exclude the big fun
  mainstream sets. Film is a real lane, not filler: a rep/arthouse regular (Vidiots, Vista,
  New Bev, Cinematheque) where the format is part of the draw — 70mm/35mm prints, restorations,
  Q&As — and a director-event (Nolan, PTA, Tarantino, Lynch tier) is worth building a night
  around; judge the movie and the print, not just the room (see the `film:` block).

categories:
  high:    # weight +3 each match
    - house / techno / tech-house / acid / electro / minimal / melodic — DJ sets of all sizes
    - mainstream & festival-scale house / tech-house headliners (John Summit,
      Dom Dolla, Gorgon City, etc.) — big-room fun counts, not just the underground
    - fabric-London-style proper club nights / European-leaning dance lineups
    - rooftop / sunset / daytime open-air house, disco, Balearic, groove sets
    - vinyl-only / all-vinyl / listening-bar DJ sets
    - warehouse and afterhours parties (incl. location-TBA)
    - melodic/organic/afro house + progressive (Anjuna/Innervisions/Keinemusik/Afterlife orbit)
    - rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, Brain Dead, Cinematheque, New Bev)
    - small rock / indie band shows at clubs (Troubadour, Echo, Zebulon, Moroccan, Lodge Room,
      Teragram) — post-punk, indie, garage, dream-pop, experimental, krautrock-y
    - Goldenvoice events
  medium:  # weight +2
    - live electronic / electronic-adjacent acts (Rüfüs Du Sol, ODESZA, Bonobo, Jamie xx tier)
    - daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / design markets (Rose Bowl Flea, Melrose Trading
      Post), farmers markets (esp. Silver Lake/eastside), food & drink pop-ups, brand activations
      / block parties / spritz-type parties, neighborhood street fairs
    - record fairs, listening bars, food events with a music angle
    - craft beer events / brewery takeovers / festivals
    - theater (Pantages-scale and black-box)
    - concerts of big name artists (Kendrick Lamar, Kacey Musgraves, Tame Impala) — mostly to stay informed
  low:     # weight +1, include only if exceptional
    - standup comedy — NOT generally wanted; only known/favorite names (see comedians_loved)

boosts:    # +1 each (stack)
  - rooftop / open-air / sunset / golden-hour setting
  - vinyl-only or "all night long" / open-to-close single-DJ sets
  - European vibe/feel — UK/EU DJs, labels (fabric, Rush Hour, Running Back, Defected, Hot Creations,
    Innervisions, Keinemusik) / Balearic-disco
  - groove / soulful / deep / dub / disco-leaning house
  - lineup artist in artists_tracked (also gets a "tracked" badge; effectively +2 via the list)
  - walkable or short drive from Silver Lake (Hyperion & Del Mar)
  - Friday or Saturday night
  - independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA, 6AM, Dirty Epic) — +1 per source
  - RA pick flag
  - early-bird ticket tier still available / on-sale or selling fast

penalties: # -2 each (the expanded non-priority list)
  - Vegas-style bottle-service / table-service clubs (Hakkasan/Marquee energy)
  - generic Top-40 / open-format / hip-hop "club night" with no real DJ billing
  - hardstyle / gabber / happy-hardcore / hard-dance as the main draw (not the lane)
  - dubstep / riddim / bass-music mega-shows, brostep
  - 18+ EDM mega-raves built on production over selection
  - tribute / cover bands, "[decade] night" nostalgia club nights
  - sports-bar watch parties, trivia, open-mics, networking mixers, webinars
    (World Cup etc. belongs in "Around town," not the picks)
  - country, Christian, kids/family programming
  - far-flung (Temecula / Anaheim / OC / SD / Ventura / SF) unless genuinely worth the trip
  - Coachella-tier logistics without Coachella-tier payoff

profile.profile_yaml:
# profile.yaml — place + person *infrastructure* config for the scoring engine and fetchers.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lifted out of Python (the term lists + geo in build_dashboard.py, the dma/area ids in the
# fetchers) so the engine is city/person-configurable and the scoring logic can live in ONE
# place: scripts/lib/scoring.py. Split of concerns:
#   taste.yaml  = CONTENT  — what Ari likes (artists_tracked, venues_loved, lanes)
#   profile.yaml = MECHANISM — source ids, home/geo, scoring weights, term matchers, thresholds
# Change city/person by swapping this file; the scoring code doesn't change.
# Values below are transcribed verbatim from the pre-refactor build_dashboard.py (behavior-preserving).

city: Los Angeles
timezone: America/Los_Angeles

# Home base — drives the "close to home" boost and the night-planner's travel times.
home:
  neighborhood: Silver Lake
  cross_streets: Hyperion & Del Mar
  coords: [ 34.0906, -118.2717 ] # ~Hyperion & Del Mar; used by scripts/lib/geo.py

# City-specific source ids (lifted from the fetchers; they fall back to these literals).
sources:
  ticketmaster_dma_id: "324" # LA DMA — fetch_ticketmaster.py
  ra_area_id: 23 # RA's internal LA area number — fetch_ra.py

pipeline:
  # Out-of-market drop (Ari, 2026-07-17): TM's DMA 324 reaches Palm Springs / Paso Robles /
  # SD-adjacent venues; rows whose neighborhood is listed here are dropped at merge time
  # UNLESS radar-worthy (festival title / tracked artist / arena-tier venue — so Coachella,
  # a tracked name at Pappy's, or a Yaamava headliner still gets captured). This is the
  # >~80-mile line; day-trip far (Anaheim/OC/Riverside/Ventura/Ojai) stays in-catalog and is
  # handled by the far scoring penalty instead. Edit freely — it's policy, not code.
  out_of_market:
    - palm springs
    - rancho mirage
    - palm desert
    - cabazon
    - coachella
    - indio
    - pioneertown # Pappy & Harriet's — tracked/festival bookings survive via the radar door
    - yucaipa
    - san bernardino
    - highland # Yaamava sits here — its arena headliners survive via the radar door
    - san diego
    - santa barbara
    - paso robles
    - san luis obispo
    - bakersfield
    - palmdale
    - temecula
    # out-of-state junk that occasionally rides in via TM/Eventbrite fetcher noise:
    - bolingbrook
    - portland
    - sunrise

scoring:
  # Base category weight, mirroring taste.yaml high/medium/low. Comedy is special-cased in code
  # (suppressed unless a loved comedian). Unknown categories default to 1.
  category_weights:
    electronic: 3
    party: 3 # club / warehouse / afterhours
    film: 3 # rep & arthouse cinema
    music: 2 # live music (catalog's term)
    live_music: 2
    theater: 2
    beer_food: 2
    comedy: 1
    art: 1
    pop: 1
    general: 1

  # Raw-score -> 1..5 star rating. [min_score, rating], checked high-to-low; below all => 1.
  rating_thresholds:
    - [ 8, 5 ]
    - [ 6, 4 ]
    - [ 4, 3 ]
    - [ 2, 2 ]

  # Neighborhoods walkable / a short drive from home (+1). Matched case-insensitively.
  near_home_neighborhoods:
    - silver lake
    - silverlake
    - echo park
    - los feliz
    - east hollywood
    - atwater village
    - atwater
    - frogtown
    - elysian valley
    - highland park
    - eagle rock
    - glassell park
    - cypress park
    - lincoln heights
    - chinatown
    - virgil village
    - westlake
    - historic filipinotown
    - downtown
    - dtla
    - arts district

  # +1: rooftop / vinyl / groove setting.
  groove_terms:
    - vinyl
    - all night
    - open to close
    - open-to-close
    - groove
    - disco
    - soulful
    - deep house
    - balearic
    - rooftop
    - sunset
    - golden hour
    - open-air
    - open air
    - daytime
    - day party
    - poolside
    - pool party
    - beach

  # +1: European label / vibe.
  eu_terms:
    - fabric
    - defected
    - innervisions
    - keinemusik
    - hot creations
    - rush hour
    - running back
    - anjuna
    - afterlife
    - dirtybird
    - hot since
    - solid grooves

  # -2 each distinct term: the expanded non-priority list (off-taste programming).
  penalty_terms:
    - bottle service
    - bottle-service
    - vip table
    - table service
    - top 40
    - top-40
    - open format
    - open-format
    - hip hop
    - hip-hop
    - hardstyle
    - gabber
    - dubstep
    - riddim
    - brostep
    - tribute
    - cover band
    - watch party
    - world cup
    - fifa
    - sports bar
    - trivia
    - bingo
    - open mic
    - karaoke
    - networking
    - webinar
    - workshop
    - virtual
    - zoom
    - mega-rave
    - mega rave
    - edm festival

  # -2: far-flung (not worth the trip by default).
  far_terms:
    - anaheim
    - santa ana
    - irvine
    - san diego
    - temecula
    - ventura
    - riverside
    - long beach
    - costa mesa
    - huntington beach
    - paso robles
    - laguna beach
    - rancho mirage
    - palm springs
    - san bernardino
    - bakersfield

  # Spotify + feedback music layer (Phase C). The affinity artifact
  # (data/spotify_affinity.json) is built by scripts/fetch_spotify.py from top/followed/
  # recently-played and folded with the feedback log; the scorer turns it into points here.
  # Spotify ENRICHES taste.yaml — it never overwrites it. Tune freely; all optional.
  spotify:
    # Points an affinity artist contributes when it appears in a lineup/title, by tier.
    # `hidden` = a feedback "never show" down-rank.
    tier_points:
      core: 3 # long-term top / followed / multi-signal — your spine; reliably clears ★4
      strong: 2 # heavy rotation — a real nudge above "on rotation"
      light: 1 # on rotation — a gentle bump
      hidden: -3 # feedback: never show this artist
    artist_cap: 5
      # max total artist-affinity points per event (a core + a strong both register;
      # a stacked dream lineup still can't run away)
    genre_points: 1 # points when a high-affinity Spotify genre appears in the haystack
    genre_threshold: 0.5 # min normalized (0..1) genre affinity to count
    genre_cap: 1 # max genre points per event (kept conservative — genre match on free text is noisy)
    min_name_len: 3 # skip ultra-short artist names (avoid false substring matches)
    # Single-word artist names that are also common English/party words or surnames (the band
    # Train, the rapper Future, the tech-house FISHER). These only count when they match a
    # structured lineup ENTRY, never loose title text — shared by the Spotify layer AND the
    # tracked-artist/radar matchers (Track B3: 'Fisher and Thames' must not badge FISHER,
    # 'The Drama' must not badge DRAMA). Grow this as you spot more.
    ambiguous_names:
      [
        train,
        future,
        juice,
        jungle,
        lights,
        justice,
        work,
        sanctuary,
        paradise,
        chance,
        hold,
        alive,
        fisher,
        drama
      ]

  # Feedback loop (Phase C). Reactions in data/feedback.jsonl fold into the affinity layer
  # automatically (no hand-merge into taste.yaml). Each weight nudges an artist/genre; once
  # the summed weight clears affinity's tier thresholds it scores like a Spotify artist.
  feedback:
    weights:
      loved: 2.0 # "more like this"
      went: 1.5 # you went
      clicked_ticket: 0.5 # implicit — emitted by the digest/dashboard delivery surfaces (Phase B/D)
      added_calendar: 0.5 # implicit — ICS export / save-to-calendar
      skipped: -0.5 # soft down-nudge
      hide: -10.0 # "never show" — forces the `hidden` tier (hard down-rank)

# Travel / geography for the night-planner (scripts/lib/geo.py). Used to sequence
# dinner -> show -> afters with rough drive/walk times. The LA neighborhood-centroid
# and venue->neighborhood gazetteers are code defaults in geo.py (same idiom as the
# scoring term-lists); override or extend them here per city/person. Only the tunable
# `travel` knobs live here by default — add `neighborhoods:` / `venues:` to override.
geo:
  travel:
    walk_max_miles: 0.8 # at/under this straight-line distance, prefer walking
    walk_min_per_mile: 20.0 # ~3 mph
    drive_floor_min: 8 # any drive costs at least this (parking, getting going)
    park_buffer_min: 6 # find parking + walk from the car
    short_min_per_mile: 4.0 # surface streets w/ lights (~15 mph effective)
    long_min_per_mile: 2.4 # some freeway on longer hops (~25 mph effective)
    short_threshold_miles: 4 # beyond this, the tail is freeway-paced
  # neighborhoods:             # uncomment to override geo.py's LA centroids
  #   Silver Lake: [34.0869, -118.2702]
  # venues:                    # uncomment to map venues -> neighborhood for blank/city-level records
  #   Zebulon: Frogtown
